_note: Tarrowby Logistics office kit (wave 2, plan 4.3; brief WAVE2_BUILD.md D12). Sources carry no position: with no position an object binds to the drawn prop of its type on the room's Tiled map (rooms.js findMatchFor :261-284, applyScenarioObjectPosition :2495). kit_vending binds to the drinks_vending1 prop drawn at tile (6.94, 9.38) on room_aw_tarrowby, against the bottom wall, so useFrom is north (dx 0, dy -1). Staff carry one thirst need and a coordinate needsHome at a supported south desk chair (aw_chair_south_slate1, chairs drawn at tiles 1.62/2.88/4.12, y 6.78): they leave home, drink at the vending and sit again (D12, proof 11). Homes are best-estimate seat tiles, confirmed and adjusted by gate D proof 11. The test fixture test_ca_office_kit keeps the gate placeholder positions and shortened timings through the override on its episodes.json row. Pool lines: awareness level, nothing that blames anyone.

ca02_enable_editing._note: ca02 colleague request (WAVE5_BUILD.md s7). Chidi, the fleet coordinator, has opened a CV for the driver job. The page is blank except for a box telling him to enable editing, then content. Word's yellow bar shows on any file from email, so the lure is the document's own text. Wrong or no answer: Fatima, the host, says IT have cut Chidi's machine off (row 8, a host mapping), and the PC shows the isolated look (moved). Right answer (report): done after 4 s. Chidi is frozen on needs and never suspended. Zainab is suspended on out and resumed on done, with no lines and no walk, so she cannot talk over Chidi. D290: Trusting Liam's look-alike careers link (e2_portfolio_lookalike) leaves kit_ca02_portal_caught false (the engine writes the caught side only: Report, Delete or Verify sets it); 9 s after Chidi's ask Fatima says the password line, once, whenPerceivable, and only if Chidi's choice has not already started the enable reaction (enable or silent), so her two lines can never overlap.
